scope: full Quaia G20 exact Gaia ID covariance supplementation

subset_job.query: SELECT g.source_id,g.pmra_pmdec_corr,g.ruwe,g.astrometric_params_solved FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source AS g JOIN TAP_UPLOAD.ids AS u ON g.source_id=u.source_id

caveats: Relative selection values/templates are covariates, not absolute inclusion probabilities or inverse weights.
Measured PM cut and upstream Gaia classifiers make intrinsic untruncated Gaussian inference unqualified.
No cross-source covariance, acceleration, congruence transfer or original K03 admission is supplied.
